body:
Hey Dario, I'm the author of MintRadar, an open-source site that keeps an eye on public Cashu mints: uptime and latency checked every 5 minutes, plus a history of key, keyset and fee changes.

Saw this issue and thought it might help. The public API could feed a discovery screen directly: a list of mints with uptime, input fees and supported NUTs, with filters for method, max input fee, NUTs and unit. The changes field could also let Macadamia warn users when a mint they already use changes its keys or fees.

It's free and read-only (no key, additive changes only), and the health records are also signed on Nostr (kind 30385). Just operational data, no verdict on solvency or custody.

Docs: https://mintradar.org/for-wallets
Closing: this branch is 486 commits behind release and superseded by the current input handling. Local branch removed.
